en.topic_title: Suicide among children and teens hit ten-year high last year, but overall figures decline – NGO
en.topic_summary:
The suicide rate among Hong Kong children and teens hit a 10-year high last year, an NGO has said, as it urged the government to expand its existing suicide prevention mechanism for students.



Hongkongers walk in rain in July 2026 . Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



The Samaritan Befrienders Hong Kong (SBHK) said at a Thursday press conference that Hong Kong saw 1,019 suicide cases in 2025, citing figures from the Coroner’s Court.



The overall suicide rate dropped from 15.1 per 100,000 peo
